name: app-6a79d492060481919fb188c452851097
description: Vivideo helps users create AI videos from text or images, build presenter videos, estimate generation credits, and view videos saved in their Vivideo account through ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Create a scroll-stopping product video ad from this image, designed for Instagram Reels and TikTok.
interface.longDescription: Vivideo helps users create AI videos from text or images, build presenter videos, estimate generation credits, and view videos saved in their Vivideo account through ChatGPT. When a user asks for a video, Vivideo can write a video plan first (title, script, style and scenes) that the user can review and change before the video is made. Videos can be checked and played in ChatGPT, and the video library shows videos made in ChatGPT and in the Vivideo app.

positive.description: A free account asks for a video and gets a video plan written by Vivideo.
positive.prompt: Create a short video about how bees make honey.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Vivideo plan card with a title, a one-line script, a style and numbered scenes with voiceover lines, written by Vivideo's planner (it can show "Putting your plan together" for a few seconds first). ChatGPT adds only one short sentence. No video is rendered and no credits are charged.
The plan card shows "Updating plan" and then the rewritten plan with the change applied.

positive.description: Generate the video from the plan on a free account.
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows a short production progress (about 10 seconds), then a blurred preview of the result with "Your video is ready!" and a play button. On the free plan the full video is made once the user starts a Vivideo plan, as in the Vivideo app: the play button opens the Vivideo app's plans page, signed in to the same account. ChatGPT itself shows no prices and no purchase links. The Generate video button in the card does the same.

positive.description: Ask about the planned video later.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the same plan's current state in the card: the preview for a free account, or the playing video once it has been made.

positive.description: Find and play an existing video from the account's library.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newest completed video in the account and shows it in the Vivideo video card with an inline player, a Download button and an Open in Vivideo link.

negative.description: Do not trigger Vivideo for a current weather request.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Istanbul?

negative.description: Do not trigger Vivideo for general writing that does not request a video.
negative.prompt: Write a customer-support email apologizing for a delayed delivery.

negative.description: Do not trigger Vivideo for an educational explanation without a generation request.

publication.release_notes: Vivideo can now write a video plan (title, script, style, scenes) that users review and change before the video is made. The video card opens reliably and plays videos made in the Vivideo app, the library lists them too, and the cards follow the user's language.
